headline: Kyrgyzstan and Armenia intend to expand trade and economic cooperation
summary: Kyrgyzstan and Armenia intend to broaden trade and economic cooperation, according to a meeting between Kyrgyz deputy foreign minister Mederbek Abakirov and Armenian counterparts. Details were not specified in the report.
why: Bilateral trade agreements between Eurasian Economic Union members can shape tariffs, logistics and regional commerce for both economies.
original_headline: Кыргызстан и Армения намерены расширять торгово-экономическое сотрудничество
